description: This file contains NCCL (NVIDIA Collective Communications Library) utility functions and wrappers for CUDA tensor operations, including conversions, error handling, and collective communication primitives such as broadcast, reduce, all_reduce, reduce_scatter, all_gather, and point-to-point send/recv, specifically tailored for PyTorch's CUDA backend.

classes.name: AutoNcclGroup
classes.description: RAII class managing NCCL group scope, supporting non-blocking and blocking modes, ensuring proper start and end of NCCL collective groups.

methods.name: to_nccl_comm
methods.description: Converts a torch::cuda::nccl::ncclComm_t pointer or value to NCCL's ncclComm_t type via reinterpret_cast.

methods.name: to_nccl_unique_id
methods.description: Converts a torch::cuda::nccl::ncclUniqueId pointer to NCCL's ncclUniqueId type.

methods.name: to_nccl_result
methods.description: Maps torch::cuda::nccl::ncclResult enum to NCCL's ncclResult_t type.

methods.name: from_nccl_result
methods.description: Converts NCCL's ncclResult_t to torch::cuda::nccl::ncclResult enum.

methods.name: to_nccl_data_type
methods.description: Maps ATen scalar types or tensors to NCCL data types.

methods.name: to_nccl_red_op
methods.description: Converts an integer to NCCL reduction operation type.

methods.name: nccl_use_nonblocking
methods.description: Checks environment variable to determine if non-blocking NCCL communication is enabled.

methods.name: nccl_nonblocking_timeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for non-blocking NCCL operations, defaulting to 30 minutes.

methods.name: throw_nccl_error
methods.description: Throws an exception with NCCL error string based on NCCL result status.

methods.name: get_communicators
methods.description: Retrieves or creates NCCL communicators for a list of tensors based on their devices.

methods.name: check_tensor
methods.description: Validates that tensors are CUDA, contiguous, and on correct devices with matching sizes and types.

methods.name: check_inputs
methods.description: Validates input and output tensor lists for collective operations, ensuring device and size consistency.
